english.title: Make misleading / false / deceptive statement to induce someone to enter into / refrain from relevant agreement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), recklessly made a

(A)_[statement]_
(B)_[promise]_
(C)_[forecast]_

which was misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular for the purpose of inducing or being reckless as to whether it may have induced another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to

(D)_[enter]_
(E)_[offer to enter]_
(F)_[refrain from entering]_
(G)_[refrain from offering to enter]_

into a relevant agreement
english.legislation: Contrary to section 397(2)(a) and (8) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) Section 397(9) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that sections 397(1) and (2) do not apply unless:-
(a) the statement, promise or forecast is made in or from, or the facts are concealed in or from, the United Kingdom or arrangements are made in or from the United Kingdom for the statement, promise or forecast to be made or the facts to be concealed;
(b) the person on whom the inducement is intended to or may have effect is in the United Kingdom; or
(c) the agreement is or would be entered into or the rights are or would be exercised in the United Kingdom.
(ii) Section 397(9) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that 'Relevant agreement' means an agreement:-
(a) the entering into or performance of which by either party constitutes an activity of a specified kind or one which falls within a specified class of activity; and (b) which relates to a relevant investment.
(iii) Section 401 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the Authority or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
